data.title: 史黛菈 · 天台长椅的霸道投喂
data.description: 天台长椅上微风拂动红发双马尾，史黛菈气鼓鼓地鼓着脸颊。她用筷子夹着肉丸递到你唇边，红眸中满是吃醋的小委屈，命令你必须一口吃掉并夸奖她。
data.location: school rooftop beside chain link fence
data.action: sitting on bench, feeding partner with chopsticks, pouting cheeks in jealousy, blushing passionately
data.lighting: bright high-noon sun casting sharp clear shadows
data.mood: tsundere possessiveness, intense domestic sweetness, pure romantic devotion
data.promptProse: Sitting on a rooftop bench, Stella Vermillion pouts adorably as she feeds partner with chopsticks, blushing with fierce love.
data.animaCaption: Stella pouting with flushed cheeks while feeding partner on the school rooftop.
